knownIssues.description: Some pushed editors delete the record but leave its now-missing detail page visible. Tap the native Back button once to return to the section list.
After using nested nutrition or label editors, saving a new item can leave a blank pushed destination. The item was saved: tap Back, then reopen it from its section list.

pngStorage: Original resolution; lossless IDAT recompression only
